review.brief_reason: The rewrite is the exact algebraic split (N + 13.617068*S)/S = N/S + 13.617068 with S = sin(cos(cos(logP**4))), valid wherever S != 0. Domain is identical for both forms: S is confined to [sin(cos(1)), sin(1)] ~ [0.514, 0.842] and never vanishes, and the log argument sin(logP) + 2.3920753 lies in [1.392, 3.392] > 0, so both expressions are defined for all real logP. Same single variable logP, same real operators, no protected operators involved. The proposed form removes one redundant occurrence of the nested trig term, so it is genuinely simpler.
